items.title: Going Mad Looking For the OBELISK on Iakara! - DYSPLACED
items.description: With the newest update to Dysplaced, we can now unlock new areas on older islands. I quickly wanted to do this before exploring the new island, Iakara, some more. With not much interesting stuff found in those older caves, we head back and check out the northern swampy region of Iakara. There was not a lot here, and I became kinda annoyed at the lack of purpose on this part of the island. There were buildings and camps, but they had neither lore, a reason for existing within the world, nor anything worth looting (if there was something to loot). After some time, I did find the Obelisk that unlocks the map of the area, after I explored 90% of it. Wanna find people with a similar interest in survival games? items.title: I Found A MYSTERIOUS Machine on the NEW ISLAND, Iakara! - DYSPLACED
items.description: Dysplaced released update 0.8! Introducing a brand new island named Iakara, steel gear, a new boss, and much more! Today, we look at the perks that were added a little while ago and head to this new region. Heat protection is advised as this is the first island that gives you temperature troubles. When we arrive here we meet some locals who have been driven out of their village by the Eternals. So we take up arms and recapture their homes, and in return we gain citizenship and a house, which is the first time a major actually gave us something. However, our home is already on Anneke. items.title: What 75 Hours in Valheim Looks Like
items.description: Valheim 1.0 the Deep North is out! This added many new buildings, crafting items, and the final biome and boss of the game. However, a little over a month ago, I wanted to get back into Valheim, after getting hyped up for this update. I had not touched the game in a few years as the Mistlands broke my motivation to play. I decided to restart from 0 and work my way back up and see how for I can get before update 1.0 is released. This time also playing a little smarter. So, follow my 75 hour long journey through the 10th realm, as we survive, beat massive bosses, and build a mega island base! Wanna find people with a similar interest in survival games? Check out my Steam Group Survival Game Nest and stay up to date with the latest releases or find people to talk with or play games with. https://steamcommunity.com/groups/survivalgamenest #gameplay #valheim 0:00 My original Valheim journey 1:44 Mistlands frustration 2:41 Starting the 11th world 5:05 Entering the Black Forest 6:48 Preparing for the Elder 13:27 Defeating the Elder 14:21 Swamp exploration and mining 17:53 Base expansion and iron gear 20:02 Bone Mass confrontation 23:00 Mountain silver mining 25:00 Refining the main base 27:20 Dragon boss Moder 32:02 Plains and magic farming 36:49 Final boss and wrap up

items.title: I Fully Terraformed and Explored SKEO! - Planet Crafter
items.description: Skeo is the latest end game moon added to Planet Crafter, a beautiful moon (once terraformed) filled with long extinct animals. (like massive Sand Worms). It is among the shorter experiences the game has to offer, even though you need the most amount of TI to complete this planet. However, by the time you get here we have access to so many high tier machines that it was pretty easy. You were meant to take supplies from your main planet, but this was not even anywhere near necessary, unlike Aqualis, the other end game moon. My only complaint about this one has been the story, while it is leagues better than the previously mentioned one (because it had none). Skeo leaves some questions unanswered and very open. At the end, we set up an amber drill to get amber to our main base, and when we went back to Prime, we worked some on my mega project, and explored the new wreck added during this update, to finally find the lava lamp!!! Wanna find people with a similar interest in survival games? Check out my Steam Group Survival Game Nest and stay up to date with the latest releases or find people to talk with or play games with. https://steamcommunity.com/groups/survivalgamenest #gameplay #planetcrafter

items.title: Tips for Decorating Bases (In and Outdoors)- Eden Crafters (Echo Prime)
items.description: My main base on this planet has been sitting empty for almost 2 years now! It is time to furnish it and improve the outside a little as well. In this video, I go over some tips and tricks that I use when decorating a space. These work in most sandbox survival/crafting games. I talk about making separate rooms, mixing up a path, custom builds, and what to avoid when decorating a larger space. However, before we start any of this, I wanted to read about the lore of echo prime and show you every mural location. Wanna find people with a similar interest in survival games?
